import MilneLib.Affine.GaloisStableSections
import MilneLib.Affine.SemilinearGaloisDescent
import MilneLib.Quotient.GaloisQuotient
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFiniteAtlasOver

/-!
# Base change of a finite Galois quotient

The invariant quotient of a stable affine chart becomes the original chart
after extending scalars. Applying the open-cover criterion for pullback
squares promotes this affine calculation to the canonical finite quotient.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  (act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X)
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Scalar extension of a stable affine invariant quotient recovers its
source chart, with the canonical quotient projection as the first leg. -/
theorem stableAffineQuotientMap_isPullback_of_galois
    (C : StableAffineOpen act) :
    let pK := p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let hK := galois_action_comp_base act p hact
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK C.U
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act C.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK C.stable
    IsPullback (stableAffineQuotientMap act pK hK C) (C.U.ι ≫ p)
      (affineInvariantQuotientBaseMap
        (k := K) (A := Γ(X, C.U)) (G := L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
  let pK := p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
  let hK := galois_action_comp_base act p hact
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK C.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p C.U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act C.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK C.stable
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p C.U
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact C.stable
  let e := C.affine.isoSpec ≪≫
    (GaloisDescent.affineGaloisPullbackIso K L (Γ(X, C.U) : Type u)).symm
  refine IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨?_⟩ e ?_ ?_
  · simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      stableAffineQuotientMap_comp_base act pK hK C
  · change C.affine.isoSpec.hom ≫
      (GaloisDescent.affineGaloisPullbackIso K L (Γ(X, C.U) : Type u)).inv ≫
        pullback.fst _ _ = _
    rw [GaloisDescent.affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_fst]
    change C.affine.isoSpec.hom ≫
      affineInvariantQuotientMap (k := K) (A := Γ(X, C.U))
        (G := L ≃ₐ[K] L) = _
    rfl
  · change C.affine.isoSpec.hom ≫
      (GaloisDescent.affineGaloisPullbackIso K L (Γ(X, C.U) : Type u)).inv ≫
        pullback.snd _ _ = _
    rw [GaloisDescent.affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_snd]
    exact isoSpec_hom_comp_structureMap p C.affine

variable [CompactSpace X]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The canonical quotient of a finite semilinear Galois action descends the
acted scheme: its square with the two field structure maps is a pullback. -/
theorem finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isPullback_of_galois
    (h : OrbitsInAffineOpen act) :
    let pK := p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let hK := galois_action_comp_base act p hact
    IsPullback (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act pK hK h) p
      ((finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData act pK hK h).map
        (finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum act pK hK h))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
  let pK := p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
  let hK := galois_action_comp_base act p hact
  let D := finiteStableQuotientCrossChartDatum act pK hK h
  let M := finiteStableQuotientBaseMapData act pK hK h
  let q := finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act pK hK h
  change IsPullback q p (M.map D)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
  apply Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover q p (M.map D) _ D.toGlueData.openCover
  intro i
  let C := finiteStableAffineChart act h i
  let hchart := (finiteStableQuotientChart_isPullback act pK hK h i).flip
  have hlocal := stableAffineQuotientMap_isPullback_of_galois act p hact C
  change IsPullback (finiteStableQuotientChartMap act pK hK h i)
    ((finiteStableAffineCover act h).f i ≫ p) (M.chartMap i)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) at hlocal
  change IsPullback (pullback.snd q (D.toGlueData.ι i))
    (pullback.fst q (D.toGlueData.ι i) ≫ p)
    (D.toGlueData.ι i ≫ M.map D)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
  refine hlocal.of_iso hchart.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · change finiteStableQuotientChartMap act pK hK h i =
      hchart.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd q (D.toGlueData.ι i)
    exact hchart.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · simpa only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
      (congrArg (fun f => f ≫ p) hchart.isoPullback_hom_fst).symm
  · exact (M.ι_map D i).symm
  · simp

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
